summary: Sealed car park beside the oval and clubhouse, homes across the road.
reasons: Sealed car park, open to Union Street

drivers.seclusion: Clubhouse and oval to the north and east; nearest dwellings are 24 m or more away across the road or beyond the west edge.
drivers.access_and_room: Open sealed car park with direct entry from Union Street and about 30 marked bays.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street; little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Full of cars by day in the QLD image, so a van fits in; the night use is unknown.

flags: Signs on the street: 2P Mon-Fri 8am-5:30pm and No Stopping; none seen for the car park
Toowong Creek 137 m away; elevation 12-14 m
sun_shade: Open sky; clubhouse and trees shade the north-west corner, the oval is open to the east.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is locked or time-limited

best_section.where: north edge of the car park, towards the oval end, below the clubhouse
